name: Hardware Corner: RTX 5070 Ti, llama.cpp CUDA, Qwen3 32B Q4_K XL GGUF, decode 37.29 t/s @16k ctx
methodology: THIRD-PARTY MEASURED (hardware-corner.net local-LLM GPU ranking, accessed 2026-10-14). llama.cpp CUDA build, Qwen3 weights in 'Q4K XL' GGUF (their standard quant; nearest repo format gguf-q4-k-m), batch 1. Metrics are per-request decode tok/s (tg, output tokens/s for a single stream) and prompt-processing pp512 tok/s; both measured at ~16384-token context. NOT aggregate batch throughput. Decode 37.29 t/s at 16k context for RTX 5070 Ti.
notes: Single-card consumer/workstation row. Value is per-request decode for ONE request, directly comparable to other hwcorner-* rows at the same context; the same page publishes short-context numbers that are higher.
